scope: Selected primary documents checked October30; original dates preserved. Public account search is incomplete.

stories.title: DTCC launches its Canton-connected tokenization service
stories.summary: DTS is connected to Canton and private Besu. The announcement concerns DTC-held securities, not a cLTC integration.
stories.whyItMatters: Do not infer a Litecoin partnership from shared infrastructure.

stories.title: Luxxfolio explores cLTC liquidity with Greywick
stories.summary: The October29 release proposes seed liquidity and borrowing research; commercial terms and any treasury allocation remain conditional.
stories.whyItMatters: No completed reserve transfer or guaranteed yield is established.

stories.title: LitVM V2 outlines Charms work and a Zeeve migration
stories.summary: The project describes a wider interoperability route. Current docs continue to distinguish LiteForge testnet from future mainnet details.
stories.whyItMatters: A design announcement is not proof every component is live.

stories.title: Rome prepares its November4 Litecoin programme
stories.summary: AIBC lists Charlie Lee sessions at Fiera Roma. The event runs November2–5; the Litecoin programme is on November4.
stories.whyItMatters: Check the organizer schedule before travel.

stories.title: Read Fidelity’s Litecoin report with its original date
stories.summary: Fidelity examines payment uses alongside competition and valuation challenges. This is background research, not a fresh endorsement.

gaps: No price target, blanket MiCA approval, DTCC-cLTC partnership or guaranteed yield claimed.
